addons.name: AutoQuest
addons.description: Auto-accepts quests and turns them in; never picks your reward. Minimap button, /aq config for settings.

addons.name: ChatEmotes
addons.description: Twitch emote images in chat - type Kappa or LUL and the picture shows. /ce to toggle.

addons.name: DungeonLoot
addons.description: Item list from loot you see, gear you own and AtlasLoot's classic dungeons. /dl to open.

addons.name: FiveSecondRule
addons.description: A bar that sweeps across your mana bar for 5 s after a mana-costing spell. When it is gone, regen is back. /fsr to test, /fsr reset to re-anchor.

addons.name: GloveMill
addons.description: Buys any item you name under a price cap (one per click), disenchants it (one per click), tallies the mats and assumed profit. Minimap button; /gm config.

addons.name: LayerProbe
addons.description: Watches creature GUIDs to find your layer/shard id. /lp for the verdict, /lp reset to clear.

addons.name: LowVendorHighlight
addons.description: Outlines the bag slot whose item the vendor pays the least for. /lvh toggles, /lvhd dumps values.

addons.name: QuestRewards
addons.description: Quest rewards you can plan for, including quests you cannot take yet. /qr to open.

addons.name: RangeNum
addons.description: Big range number for hunters. /rn to toggle lock.

addons.name: RecipeAtlas
addons.description: Browse every crafting recipe this client knows, with reagents and sources. /ra to open.
